朝鮮總督府統計年報 1916

Chōsen Sōtokufu tōkei nenpō (Statistical Annual of the Government-General of Korea), 大正五年 (Taishō 5), published 1918
朝鮮總督府, 京城, 1918 (大正七年)

All 604 numbered tables and the appendix table are transcribed (610 tables, about 328,000 cells), with the contents; the 凡例, the contents pages and the colophon are not. Tables printed across both pages of a spread are joined into one; long tables were read in sections by different readers and joined. Each spread was read once by a Claude Sonnet agent from tight crops, with no second reading. 655 cells could not be read and are marked [?]. Printed totals were re-added; many that do not add up (often by a round 10, 100 or 1,000, which points to misprints in the original) are kept as printed and noted, and where a digit was ambiguous only between 3 and 8 and exactly one reading made a printed total reconcile, that reading is used and noted. Small figures printed above a main figure (marked ×, ※ or *) are kept in the same cell after it. Where the original prints a question mark (unknown figures for early years) it is kept as ?.
